title: Printable 360° protractor (paper) or a school protractor
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 1: Percentages; area, perimeter and volume; statistics; shape
source: Seeded from mathematics/y6 lessons 71, 74, 75, 76, 77, 78 (Printable 360° protractor (paper) or a school protractor)
intro: To understand how to read pie charts using fractions and angles

blocks.text: Cut out the protractor. Put the centre dot on the centre of the pie chart or the vertex of the angle, and 0° along one line. Print at 100% (actual size).

questions.q: Cycle sector is 30°. How many cycle?
What fraction travel by car?
Do the pupils total 24?
20 pupils: degrees per pupil?
With 18° per pupil, angle for 5 pupils?
Check the fruit angles total 360°.
Rain in April?
questions.model: Teacher: go up from April to the line: 45 mm.

questions.q: Mean rainfall over the 5 months?
A 120° sector of 30 pupils?
Measure angle A.
questions.model: Teacher: centre, 0 on the arm, read 64°; it looks acute ✓.

questions.q: Measure angle B.

questions.q: Three lines meet at a point: angles 2x, 3x and 4x. Find x and each angle.
Explain why vertically opposite angles are equal using angles on a line.
questions.a: Each one plus the same neighbour makes 180°, so they must be equal

A quarter of a pie chart is... A) 90° B) 25° C) 180°
Big question: why a circle?
questions.a: The whole circle is the whole group (360°), so each part is a fraction of it

questions.q: 24 pupils: degrees per pupil? A) 15° B) 24° C) 10°
Big question: how do we turn data into angles?
questions.a: Divide 360° by the total, then multiply by each count

questions.q: Best chart for parts of a whole? A) pie chart B) line graph
Big question: one strength, one target
250° is... A) reflex B) obtuse C) acute
Big question: how do we measure a reflex angle?
questions.a: Measure the small angle and subtract it from 360°

questions.q: Lines cross at 50°. Next angle? A) 130° B) 50° C) 310°
Big question: can we find angles without measuring?
questions.a: Yes: use angle facts and give a reason for each step
